column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2006's recovery-tail regression (cleat-review round 2, 2026-09-24) needs a real PostgreSQL to drive reapOnce across two real ticks and confirm sticky suppression protects still-stale rows when one worker's heartbeat lands before its siblings'. Guards on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES/CLEAT_TEST_DB being unset and skips ONCE. Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_DB go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestReapOnceRecoveryTailAgainstARealDatabase -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly 1.
